text:
maria-marketing: Quick sync: launching Sparklet next week. Need to A/B copy for the launch post, a tight benchmark narrative for the blog, webinar time decision, and how leads flow into the tutorial funnel. Can we finalize by EOD?

devon-devrel: For copy, propose two variants: 1) "Get local LLM inference in minutes" (product-first) and 2) "Ship faster: local inference with zero infra headaches" (outcome-first). We should run a small internal poll.

lily-design: I mocked two hero alternatives and two tweet cards that match those angles. Will drop PNGs in the PR. Thinking of using the micro GIF from the quickstart as social preview.

sam-growth: Timing: Thu 9am PT still looks best for EMEA. For lead routing: landing page -> choose your path (tutorial vs dedicated demo). We'll tag signups with utm_source=sparklet_launch and route dev leads into a DevRel nurture track.

akash-eng: Bench narrative: keep it simple. Show dev laptop CPU quantized perf, small GPU perf, and hosted latency baseline. Call out memory footprint (RAM after quantize) and recommended VM spec. I'll produce numbers in this format: "p50: 85ms, p95: 220ms, tokens/sec: 120" for each config.

nate-analytics: If we publish a benchmark table, we should include methodology blurb and the raw CSV. I'll host the CSV in the repo and wire an analytics event when people download. Also recommend a short explainer for cost-per-1M-tokens using conservative pricing assumptions.

maria-marketing: Good. devon — can you write the benchmark narrative paragraph (two versions: short blurb for tweet/hero and longer for blog) and add the CSV link? devon-devrel: yep, I'll draft both.

devon-devrel: Draft messaging ideas (short): Variant A (product): "Sparklet: local LLM inference in minutes — run quantized models on your laptop. Demo Thu 9am PT." Variant B (outcome): "Ship faster with local inference — prototype features without infra overhead. Join demo Thu 9am PT."

lily-design: Tweet copy candidates ready. Also made a 20s hero GIF showing `sparklet init && sparklet run --example chat`. Want to confirm exact CLI before export.

akash-eng: Confirm CLI: `npx @redwood/sparklet init && npx @redwood/sparklet run --model small --quantize`. That will be what we show. Note: quantize step takes ~30s on laptop. Mention that in tutorial.

maria-marketing: We should also prep a quick follow-up email that includes the benchmark one-pager and a link to the tutorial repo. sam-growth: can you draft the email flow?

sam-growth: Yep. Email flow: 1) immediate: webinar thank you + tutorial link, 2) 48h: benchmark one-pager + invite to office hours, 3) 7d: case study ask + feedback survey. We'll tag opens and clicks for retargeting.

nate-analytics: Also add an event for "download benchmark pdf" and "star repo" for attribution. We'll pass to Growth.

ops-bot: Created calendar event Sparklet Launch Webinar Thu 09:00 PT. Created GitHub issue #sparklet-launch-ab-test-copy and added assignees.

maria-marketing: Final checklist: 1) landing page copy + UTM (sam) — due Wed noon. 2) tutorial PR + CSV (devon) — due Tue EOD. 3) benchmark numbers + methodology (akash) — due Wed 9am. 4) hero GIF + social cards (lily) — due Wed noon. 5) email sequences + GA events (sam + nate) — due Wed EOD.

devon-devrel: I'll open PRs for both the tutorial and the benchmark CSV in `docs/sparklet` and add raw data under `docs/sparklet/benchmarks/raw`.

akash-eng: One ask: include a short note in the blog about common pitfalls (e.g., thread pinning in quantized runtimes, memory OOM on 8GB VMs). I'll write the bullet list.

maria-marketing: Great. Anyone want to run a quick internal A/B test of the two hero messages on the company beta list? Could be useful.

lily-design: I can swap hero copy in the staging page for a quick 24h test.

sam-growth: I'll seed the beta list with two variations and capture CTR.

maria-marketing: OK locking this in. Will post final launch micro-timeline tomorrow morning. Thanks team :rocket:
